briefdescription.para: isSnippet - Identify if a live interval is a snippet that should be spilled.

detaileddescription.para: It is assumed that SnipLI is a virtual register with the same original as Edit->getReg().

briefdescription.para: collectRegsToSpill - Collect live range snippets that only have a single real use.
It is beneficial to spill to earlier place in the same BB in case as follows: There is an alternative def earlier in the same MBB.

detaileddescription.para: Hoist the spill as far as possible in SpillMBB. This can ease register pressure:
x = def y = use x s = copy x
Hoisting the spill of s to immediately after the def removes the interference between x and y:
x = def spill x y = use killed x
This hoist only helps when the copy kills its source.

briefdescription.para: eliminateRedundantSpills - SLI:VNI is known to be on the stack.

detaileddescription.para: Remove any redundant spills of this value in SLI.reg and sibling copies.

briefdescription.para: markValueUsed - Remember that VNI failed to rematerialize, so its defining instruction cannot be eliminated.
reMaterializeFor - Attempt to rematerialize before MI instead of reloading.
reMaterializeAll - Try to rematerialize as many uses as possible, and trim the live ranges after.
If MI is a load or store of StackSlot, it can be removed.
foldMemoryOperand - Try folding stack slot references in Ops into their instructions.

parameterdescription.para: Load instruction to use instead of stack slot when non-null.
